scripts.text: I heard there's an old tower where horrible witches put Savages in a giant cauldron and cast evil spells on them, right?
scripts.translation: 聽說那裡有一座古老的塔，可怕的女巫們把野豬丟進巨大的鍋裡，對它們施加邪惡的咒語，對吧？

scripts.text: What's worse is that whoever takes medicine made out of Savages will come back for more!
scripts.translation: 更可怕的是，吃了用野豬做的藥的人，還會想再吃！

scripts.text: And he will wander around looking for the tower, and eventually turn into an enormous Savage!
scripts.translation: 他會四處遊蕩尋找那座塔，最後變成一頭巨大的野豬！

scripts.text: I heard that there are creeps there who won't get up at all even if it rains or snows, or their sweethearts or parents call them!
scripts.translation: 聽說那裡還有些怪人，不管下雨下雪，還是戀人、父母來叫，都不肯起來！

scripts.text: And that black clouds hover over them all the time, causing a storm!
scripts.translation: 他們頭上還總是烏雲密佈，颳風下雨！

scripts.text: Search through the vegetable-shaped drawer to my right.
scripts.translation: 去翻翻我右邊那個蔬菜形狀的抽屜吧。

scripts.text: - You don't remember how to open the warehouse. -
scripts.translation: - 你不記得怎麼開啟倉庫了。 -

scripts.text: - The figure 1 0 0 is written in small letters on the vegetable-shaped drawer. -
scripts.translation: - 蔬菜形狀的抽屜上用小字寫著數字 1 0 0。 -

scripts.text: - You don't seem to have 100 zeny with you. -
- You gave up using the warehouse. -
